requirement: Add a new operation, Close(name), which removes an account. Its checks, in order: an account that does not exist gives "unknown account NAME"; an account whose balance is not 0 gives "account NAME not empty". A closed account no longer exists: later operations on it fail with "unknown account NAME", it is left out of the result, and it may be opened again with Open (as a new account with balance 0, placed in the result by its new opening).
desc: Apply bank operations in order; steps are numbered from 1. Open(name) creates an account with balance 0. Deposit adds amount; Withdraw subtracts it; Transfer moves amount from src to dst; Close(name) removes the account, after which it no longer exists (it may be opened again later as a new account). Each operation is checked in this order, and the first failing check stops processing with an error prefixed "step N: ": Open of an existing name gives "duplicate account NAME"; an account that does not exist gives "unknown account NAME" (for Transfer, check src before dst); a Close of an account whose balance is not 0 gives "account NAME not empty"; a Transfer with src equal to dst gives "same account"; an amount of 0 or less gives "invalid amount"; a Withdraw or Transfer of more than the current balance gives "insufficient funds". If every operation succeeds, return each existing account as a (name, balance) pair, in the order the accounts were (most recently) opened.

decls.canon:
type BankOp =
  | Open(name: String)
  | Deposit(name: String, amount: Int)
  | Withdraw(name: String, amount: Int)
  | Transfer(src: String, dst: String, amount: Int)
  | Close(name: String)
